sample_type.name: CATALYST Material v1
sample_type.description: [CATALYST schema catalyst-scisure-configuration/1] Physical catalyst materials, aliquots and treated specimens. Acquisition data and processing results belong to linked experiments. No default stock mass is assigned.

definition.notes: Immutable consortium sample ID; also stored in native altID.
Independent synthesis batch; shared by its aliquots.
Lab that synthesized the original batch.
Lab that created this container/aliquot/treated sample.
Origin laboratory batch label; not a unique consortium identifier.
Batch material, aliquot, or treated material.
Canonical parent; native parentSampleID must reference its resolved SciSure sample.
Exact procedure version; independent of mapping/software versions.
Published native protocol version or exact shared procedure document reference.
The particular laboratory execution that made this batch.
YYYY-MM-DD calendar date. Text deliberately preserves date-only precision without UTC conversion.
Actual synthesis execution/ELN record, not just the shared SOP.

structure.study_basis: Acquisition/executing lab; origin lab is a separate sample field.
structure.experiment_basis: One synthesis execution or measurement/calculation acquisition; revisions remain with that work.
structure.approval_policy: Preserve the existing project/study signing and approval policy.
structure.protocols: Shared scientific procedure plus exact published protVersionID; never invent procedure content.
structure.computational_models: ELN records and versioned model manifests, not physical inventory Samples.

measurement.generated: Only a newly identified physical product/derivative

computation.used: None by default; physical comparison links are explicit evidence, not consumption

storage.originals: Revision-specific FILE section; preserve bytes and embedded metadata.
storage.standardized: Approved versioned review attachment; optional processed exports are separate artifacts.
storage.provenance: Keep normalization, scientific processing, validation, approval and publication receipt distinct.
storage.image_handling: Original file attachment; optional IMAGE sections may supplement but never replace originals.
storage.quantity: Optional inventory balance, entered separately; never infer stock mass from reactor loading.
storage.native_ids: Discover from this tenant and record in memory/remote publication receipts; never hard-code example IDs.

installation_scope: Creates only the dedicated material sample type and missing metadata fields. Does not create samples, projects, studies, protocols, sign records, or change permissions.
